title: First-occurrence weighted contraction for products of orthogonal projections
difficulty_reason: 需要把平均投影的谱隙转成任意包含全部投影的长乘积收缩，并保留首次出现时刻总和的精确尺度。核心是构造平方范数损失序列，将每个单投影偏移按其首次出现之前的路径长度收费，再利用投影正交性把平均算子交叉项变成负平方范数。加权收费与两个能量视角的组合均由本题证明承担；没有把该估计或等价定理放入先修。
core_obligations: Derive each P_j f-f displacement bound using only the prefix up to k_j
Telescope exact squared-norm losses under orthogonal projections
Convert the gap of the average into the weighted loss sum and retain sum(k_j) dependence
proof_roadmap: Define Q_l and monotone gamma_l by squared norm loss.
Use Pythagoras to identify each movement square with gamma increment.
Split P_j f-f at the first occurrence k_j and bound by prefix movements.
The average projection cross terms equal negative displacement squares; compare its assumed norm gap with accumulated loss.
